military.headline: The real interest: MILITARY SUPPLY CHAIN
military.headlineBody: The "Energy Transition" narrative is a facade. The primary driver is the US defense supply chain: F-35 (417 kg REE/unit), nuclear submarines (4,175 kg), missiles, radar, drones, electronic warfare.
military.chinaBanBody: China banned export of 12/17 REE elements to US. 78% of US weapons depend on Chinese REE. DFARS 2027 mandate: US defense contractors must source non-China REE.
military.title: title

illegal.landSpecDesc: 437 companies with speculation patterns: 100% claims after 2020, only research requests (never authorized), dozens of processes with 1-2 substances.
illegal.landSpecEx2: Nazca Gold: 129 claims, no corporate data
illegal.landSpecEx3: Pedra Cinza: 322 claims, 531,844 ha, all recent
illegal.rejeitoDesc: Sep/2025: ANM Director arrested + 21 others. Billion-dollar license manipulation scheme. 1/3 of ANM directors were former mining sector employees.
illegal.secrecyDesc: ANM allows secrecy on mining process data. 88 claims under secrecy (105,139 ha). Operação Rejeito showed secrecy enabled corruption.
illegal.secrecyEx1: 19 Nacional de Grafite claims under secrecy
illegal.secrecyEx3: ANM opened consultation to revise rules in 2025
illegal.foreignDesc: 2,142 claims (10.3%) controlled by Australian, American, Canadian and European companies. Zero domestic processing — raw ore exported.
illegal.exclusionDesc: Traditional communities, quilombolas and indigenous peoples excluded from decisions about mining on their territories.
illegal.exclusionEx1: Quilombo Kalunga do Mimoso: Federal Court suspended
illegal.exclusionEx2: 40+ quilombo territories threatened in Legal Amazon
illegal.waterDesc: REE mining consumes 400-500L/ton. Poços de Caldas already faces rationing. In-situ leaching proven to contaminate aquifers.
illegal.waterEx1: Poços de Caldas: rationing 2024, Viridis plans to use 4 reservoirs
illegal.waterEx2: ISR: proven contamination in China by same method
illegal.waterEx3: São Francisco River: Zn, Cd, Cr contamination
illegal.title: title

network.foxfireBody: Dr. Paul Woolrich connects Foxfire → Axel REE (ASX:AXL) → Si6 Metals (ASX:SI6) → Spark Energy (CSE:SPRK). 570+ claims via interconnected company network.
network.australianBody: 9 ASX companies exploring REE in Brazil. Viridis + Meteoric = Poços de Caldas. MPF sought to suspend BOTH.
network.usMilitaryBody: DFC $565M → Serra Verde. State Dept $5M → Aclara. Export Finance Australia $100M → Viridis/Meteoric. Ucore MOU → military oxide in US.
network.cbmmBody: Baosteel/CITIC/Anshan consortium holds 15% (US$1.95B). REE in niobium tailings — no specific regulation.
network.clickHint: Click a node to focus · Click empty space to clear
network.title: title

timelinePanel.title: Claiming timeline (2000–2026)
timelinePanel.footer: Yearly new claims from ANM public records; the running total compounds each year.
timelinePanel.narrativeStart: baseline: a few dozen claims a year — rare earths not yet strategic.
timelinePanel.narrative2010: China bans rare-earth exports to Japan, the first warning shot — claims jump past 500.
timelinePanel.narrative2017: the US declares rare earths critical (EO 13817); China threatens a US ban and the Pentagon starts investing.
timelinePanel.narrative2021: supercycle and Brazil rush — lithium and ASX juniors invade; 2023 peaks at 4,213 claims as the US DFC funds Serra Verde.
timelinePanel.narrative2024: backlash: prosecutors challenge licensing and Operação Rejeito arrests an ANM director, while China bans 7 rare-earth elements.

community.title: Evidence becomes collective power
community.lead: This is not a dashboard about a place. It is a community tool for reading how extraction, water, protected territories and cultural life meet around Poços de Caldas.
community.readText: Start with layers together. A claim is not a verdict: it is a public record that needs context, verification and local knowledge.
community.connectText: Cultural agents, water, protected territories and mining records reveal relationships that isolated datasets hide.
community.actText: Use Field Monitor to document observations, share a territory pin or connect with the wider Earth Guardians movement.
community.methodologyText: Data is assembled from public records and community-facing sources. Treat it as an invitation to investigate, not as a substitute for community consent or legal determination.

campaigns.title: Campaigns
campaigns.heroDesc: From civic engagement to divestment campaigns, from storytelling to large-scale tree plantings and food sovereignty initiatives — we build people power alongside coalitions of climate justice organizations to reverse climate chaos and grow a regenerative, just future.
campaigns.heroNote: “Where you see change is needing to happen, act up.”

campaigns.canStat3: Benefit concert in Manhattan to tree planting in Zambia
campaigns.stmpDesc: As members of a 130+ organization coalition, we hold the financial backers of climate chaos accountable — demanding banks, asset managers, insurers and investors stop funding, insuring and investing in climate destruction, from Chase and BlackRock to pension funds and university endowments.
campaigns.stmpStat1: $2.7 trillion poured into fossil fuels by 35 banks (2016–2019)
campaigns.stmpStat2: Targets: Chase, BlackRock, Liberty Mutual + more
campaigns.stmpStat3: Not My Dirty Money youth pledge, ages 13–25
campaigns.civicDesc: Voter registration and education for transformative change — we revolutionized the vote in 2020 with record youth and BIPOC turnout, and keep organizing to hold leaders accountable, restore voting rights and fight suppression.

campaigns.civicStat3: “The fight for justice does not stop at the ballot box”

grantsPortal.grantsCopy2: Since 2021, our Project Grants program has backed grassroots efforts in climate justice education, regenerative agriculture, tree plantings, nonviolent direct action, climate policy, food security, art-vism, & more.

queryParams.title: URL Parameters
queryParams.embed: Hides navigation, header, and map controls for clean embedding. Automatically enabled when viewport is smaller than 400×300px.
queryParams.noControl: Hides the top header and map controls (search, filters, fullscreen). The bottom dock navigation remains visible.
queryParams.hideAll: Hides everything except the globe/map and the Earth Guardians logo. No header, dock, controls, or legends.
queryParams.controls: Overrides embed/no-control mode to force-show all controls. Useful when you want full interactivity in an embedded context.
queryParams.lang: Sets the interface language (e.g., es, fr, pt).

autoHide.title: Auto-Hide Behavior
autoHide.description: Map controls (search, filters, hex grid, connections, fullscreen) automatically hide when the viewport is too small: width < 400px, height < 300px, or when both dimensions are under 500px with a near-square aspect ratio. This ensures a clean experience in small embeds like ad cards and widgets.

viewportSizes.title: Recommended Viewport Sizes
viewportSizes.banner: 728×90 or 320×50 — Banner embeds, minimal map visible.
viewportSizes.smallCard: 300×250 — Sidebar widgets, ad-sized cards. Controls auto-hidden.
viewportSizes.mediumCard: 600×400 — Blog posts and articles. Controls visible.
viewportSizes.responsive: 16:9 aspect ratio — Best for responsive layouts. Controls visible when wide enough.
viewportSizes.fullScreen: 100vw×100vh — Dedicated map pages. Full interactive experience.

security.title: Security
security.description: Embeds use sandbox attributes to restrict access. Only public data is exposed through embedded maps.

performance.title: Performance
performance.description: All embeds use lazy loading. Maps load only when scrolled into view, minimizing initial page weight.
